experiences.name: Street Food Tour in Centro Histórico
experiences.description: Explore the bustling street food scene in the heart of Mexico City. Sample tacos, tlayudas, tamales, and elotes from iconic local vendors around Mercado de San Juan and surrounding streets. A guided walk helps you discover hidden gems and understand the culinary history of Mexican cuisine.

experiences.name: Visit Templo Mayor and National Museum of Anthropology
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Aztec history at Templo Mayor, the ancient ceremonial center located steps from the Zócalo. Follow up with a visit to the nearby National Museum of Anthropology in Chapultepec to see world-class pre-Columbian artifacts and learn about Mexico's indigenous cultures.

experiences.name: Mercado de la Merced Food Exploration
experiences.description: Dive deep into one of Mexico City's largest and most authentic traditional markets. Taste regional dishes like mole, pozole, and fresh tortillas made by local vendors. This is a true locals-only experience offering an unfiltered look at everyday Mexican food culture.
experiences.location: La Merced, Centro Histórico, Mexico City

experiences.name: Lucha Libre Wrestling Show at Arena México
experiences.description: Experience the vibrant and theatrical world of Mexican Lucha Libre at Arena México, one of the most iconic wrestling venues in the world. Located in the Doctores neighborhood, it is centrally accessible and offers an electrifying cultural spectacle unique to Mexico.

experiences.name: Cooking Class in Roma Norte
experiences.description: Join a hands-on traditional Mexican cooking class in the trendy and centrally located Roma Norte neighborhood. Learn to prepare classic dishes like chiles en nogada, guacamole, and handmade tortillas under the guidance of a local chef, then enjoy your creations for lunch.
